Meanwhile, United Arab Emirates led by Ahmed Raza finished second in Group B. They won their games against Ireland and Germany but lost their last group game against Bahrain. It was a closely-fought affair and the UAE tried their best but fell short. United Arab Emirates may find it tough to get past Nepal but they are a tough side to beat and would be confident of knocking their opponents down and head into the finals. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

Nepal, led by Sandeep Lamichhane have been very clinical in their group games. They finished on top of Group A and are the only unbeaten side of the tournament so far. They are heading into this game on the back of a thumping 8-wicket victory over Canada. Sandeep Lamichhane is the leading wicket-taker and would want to continue to work his magic with the ball. They haven't allowed their opponents any sort of breather and would be confident of winning this match.

Welcome to the coverage of the first semi final of the ICC T20 World Cup Qualifier A where Nepal will take on United Arab Emirates. Both teams would eye a victory here as only a win would help them get into finals and both teams cannot afford to put a foot wrong here. Whichever side loses here gets to play for the 3rd spot. But why aim for bronze when you get gold right? Let's see which team comes out on top.
